final_message:
Configured DNS for all requested hostnames and the four mail domains. All 60 PCs point to the recursive resolver on **pc26**; pc1 serves the artificial root, and pc2–pc25 serve the delegated zones.

The configuration uses the existing IPv4 addresses and `kathara/base` images. No connections, addresses, or routes were changed. Shell syntax checks passed for all startup files; BIND validation tools were unavailable, and the lab was not started for live DNS tests.

Assumed an isolated IPv4 DNS hierarchy. The MX records identify the requested mail hosts; mail service itself was not configured.
